title: Campfire Night: the flashlight fits the phone
kaylee: On a phone, the flashlight now lights one animal at a time, like on the Mac, instead of half the clearing.

pictures.title: iPhone, light on the owl
pictures.caption: Before, one spot lit the owl, moose, frog and beaver together. Now it lights just the owl.

pictures.title: Mac, the same spot
pictures.caption: The Mac's light is the same size as before.
